Original Aurora & Colfax.name: Original Aurora & Colfax
Original Aurora & Colfax.description: East Colfax cultural arts district and the city's oldest grid with facade grants, mixed-use conversions, and steady alteration permitting.

Northwest Aurora MLK.name: Northwest Aurora MLK
Northwest Aurora MLK.description: MLK Boulevard corridor of post-war tract housing with renovation-led permitting and infill on former school sites.

Anschutz Medical Campus.name: Anschutz Medical Campus
Anschutz Medical Campus.description: Fitzsimons life-sciences anchor with continuous institutional expansion, med-ed tenancy, and the metro's densest permit velocity per parcel.

Aurora Highlands.name: Aurora Highlands
Aurora Highlands.description: Master-planned northeast growth corridor with new-build tract permitting, school-package filings, and Gaylord-scale commercial pads.

Painted Prairie.name: Painted Prairie
Painted Prairie.description: Newer mixed-housing development near Tower Road with builder-driven permit volume and neighborhood-retail pads.

Havana Business District.name: Havana Business District
Havana Business District.description: Havana BID strip with immigrant-owned small business licensing, facade improvements, and transit-adjacent infill.

Mission Viejo & Aurora Hills.name: Mission Viejo & Aurora Hills
Mission Viejo & Aurora Hills.description: Mid-century residential belt around Aurora Hills library with basement-finish and roof-permit cadence.

Southlands.name: Southlands
Southlands.description: Southeast lifestyle-retail anchor with townhome infill, E-470 pad sites, and the metro's newest-roof stock.

Seven Hills & Saddle Rock.name: Seven Hills & Saddle Rock
Seven Hills & Saddle Rock.description: Golf-course custom-build belt with high-valuation new construction and pool/deck auxiliary permits.

Piney Creek & Smoky Hill.name: Piney Creek & Smoky Hill
Piney Creek & Smoky Hill.description: Piney Creek village housing next to the Smoky Hill Road retail spine with steady renovation and business-license churn.
